items.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $76,000, but $1.3 billion ETF exodus tests recovery
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bitcoin was trading above $76,000 on Saturday, showing signs of stabilization after a bruising selloff, but another wave of withdrawals from U.S. exchange-traded funds highlighted the gap between its modest recovery and institutional demand.

items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Backed A Major Music Rights Acquisition Through Managed Funds
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) backed Influence Media Partners in acquiring Anthem Entertainment's music catalog through its managed funds, expanding exposure to music rights. Funds managed by BlackRock supported the Anthem Entertainment deal, adding a large portfolio of recorded music and publishing assets to its alternative holdings. items.title: Will the Democratic sweep cloud crypto market structure?
items.summary:
Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, putting the CLARITY Act’s path in doubt after it stalled in the Senate in September. Analysts expect tougher consumer protections and stablecoin yield limits in the next draft. Plus, Bitcoin ETFs see $430 in outflows and Canary Capital launches an INJ ETF. CoinDesk’s Jennifer Sanasie hosts “CoinDesk Daily.”

items.title: BlackRock’s Larry Fink Says America’s Workers Are Falling Behind Investors — and 25 Years of Data Explains Why
items.summary: A shoe store kid turned the world's biggest money manager says a career used to be the bedrock of America. A quarter century of paychecks, stock returns, and who actually owns the market reveals what changed, and one claim of his does not hold up.
